unit: Unit 13: Making Your Computer Easier to Use
title: Making the pointer easier to find
drDigitalIntro:
Losing the mouse pointer on a big screen is one of the most common frustrations there is.
• Larger Pointer makes the arrow noticeably bigger, so your eye catches it straight away.
• It does not change what the pointer does — only how big it looks.
• If you still lose it, shaking the mouse quickly makes the pointer grow briefly on most computers.
• This is the setting people most often say they wish they had known about years ago.

playgroundTask.goal: You made the mouse pointer bigger

steps.say: Click Accessibility in the list on the left.
Click the switch next to Larger Pointer, then move your mouse to see it.

drDigitalSuccess: Move the mouse around the desktop — the arrow is much harder to lose now.
drDigitalHint: Larger Pointer is the first switch in the Pointer and Motion card, near the bottom of the Accessibility page.
